description: Source file implementing utility functions for capability management, including logging, time formatting, string trimming, and JSON-based capability population.

methods.name: currentDateTime
methods.description: Returns the current date and time as a formatted string with milliseconds precision.

methods.name: _vscprintf
methods.description: Calculates the length of a formatted string without printing it.

methods.name: log_cap
methods.description: Logs a formatted message to a log file with a timestamp.

methods.name: trim
methods.description: Removes non-alphanumeric, underscore, and comma characters from a string.

methods.name: populate_capabilities
methods.description: Recursively populates capability list based on JSON configuration and capability string.

methods.name: get_capabilities
methods.description: Reads capabilities configuration from JSON file and populates capability structures for a given process.
